# Tom Okafor

Next door neighbour at number 12. Has the allotment plot beside mine.

- Gave me the Gardener's Delight seedlings that went into the [[Garden Log]] tomato bed.
- Lends me his long ladder for the gutters; return it the same day.
- Keeps bees on the allotment and swaps a jar of honey for a loaf now and then.
